name: CoLoTa
description: A dataset for commonsense reasoning over long-tail entities consisting of 3,300 queries from question answering and claim verification tasks, designed to assess LLMs' commonsense reasoning and robustness to hallucinations.
reputation: A recent commonsense reasoning benchmark that is mainly used in research on long-tail entities and hallucination robustness, with limited but growing adoption.
notes: Also serves as a knowledge graph question answering benchmark requiring commonsense reasoning beyond factoid questions.
